visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair, wearing headphones and a grey shirt, is shown in a small window at the top left corner, looking intensely at the screen. The main frame displays a dark, dingy room from a first-person perspective in a video game. A small child sits at a desk in the center of the dark space. (2) The camera zooms into a hole in a wall with a rough, textured surface. A greyish hand suddenly reaches out from the darkness of the hole, followed by a bright flash of light. The man in the webcam reacts with a wide-eyed expression and physical recoil. (3) The scene shifts to various dark, abandoned-looking corridors with tiled walls and a bathroom environment. A tall, pale, creepy figure in red clothing is seen peeking from behind a door and then crawling rapidly through the room on all fours. The man reacts with loud laughter and shifting facial expressions. (4) The gameplay continues in a dark room with glowing red lighting. The man hides under a desk while the tall creature with an exaggerated face crawls nearby. The man's facial expressions alternate between concentration, fear, and amusement as he observes the creature's path.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-frequency environmental hum and subtle, eerie background music with a slow tempo. The man's breathing is soft but audible. No other significant sound effects are present during this initial quiet build-up phase. (2) A sharp, loud transient sound effect resembling a heavy impact occurs, immediately followed by the man letting out a high-intensity, high-pitched shout of surprise. The BGM remains tense but is momentarily overshadowed by the man's loud vocal reaction. (3) A distinct mechanical clicking sound resembling a light switch triggers a new phase. The man begins speaking rapidly in Traditional Chinese with high pitch variability and a nervous, laughing tone. The BGM tempo remains steady and atmospheric. (4) A piercing, high-volume Jump-scare sound effect occurs, accompanied by the man yelling 'Amma!' with extremely high vocal arousal. The background music swells in intensity, featuring sharp synthesizer textures and a more driving, chaotic rhythmic feel. (5) Multiple loud, distorted vocalizing sounds from the game creature are heard, punctuated by the man's continuous loud shouting and frantic commentary. The audio mix is dense with overlapping voices, intense music, and frequent percussive sound effects from the game. (6) The audio transitions as mechanical clicking sounds become prominent. The man's voice lowers in intensity and becomes more inquisitive and analytical. The background music shifts back to a more subtle, repetitive drone with low spectral brightness.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Surprise -> Escalated Reaction -> Observation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by showcasing a humorous and high-energy reaction to a horror-themed video game jump scare.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A reaction video combining first-person horror gameplay with a face-cam overlay. The pace is rapid with many variety-show style text overlays to enhance the humor.
